title: Round 6 / ECDLP-16: relation-system solving cost at m = 3 for prime-field factor bases
question: For E/F_p (toy p up to ~2^20) and factor bases V (small-x, and PKM-type multiplicative-coset), measure the cost of FINDING decompositions R = V1+V2+V3 by algebraic system solving (resultant elimination of Semaev S_4 or S_3-chained systems with structural constraints) versus scanning, and compare the total relation-collection cost against sqrt(p) and the threshold T < p^{1/2-1/m} = p^{1/6} per relation.
claims: Semaev S_3 and S_4 (closed-form resultant) verified against toyec group law: 2400 S_3 and 2400 S_4 random tuples, 0 failures; at p=4001 the root set in x4 equals {x(+-P1+-P2+-P3)} for 300/300 triples (experimental, finite).

At m=3 on toy prime-field curves (p=4129..1061413, 2-4 curves each) no implemented method achieves per-relation cost T < p^{1/6} with |V| ~ p^{1/3}: best (M1 table) has T about 54-320 counted mults vs p^{1/6} 4-10, per-attempt exponent about 0.33; T exponent fits 0.22-0.30 (4-5 points), not < 1/6 (experimental, toy sizes, unit cost model).
PKM subgroup-coset, small-x and random factor bases of equal size have indistinguishable yield pi and cost T at m=3 on the tested domain.

Total relation-collection cost for M1 is 44-83 sqrt(p) (9-17x the analytic rho model) with fitted exponent about 0.61; linear algebra alone (model 3|V|^2 = 3p^{2/3}) exceeds sqrt(p) for |V|=p^{1/3}, so m=3 cannot beat sqrt(p) in this cost model even with T=O(1) (analytic, model-dependent).

S_4 pair-scan with root test (evaluation or gcd with X^h-c) costs about 2n^3 / n^2 log n per attempt, 300-800x above M1 at k=12,14; analytic degree bounds (>= h, h^2) for elimination (M3) were derived but not implemented or reviewed.
T below p^{1/6} occurs only for oversized |V| >= ~4p^{1/3} (T floor of one 5-unit step; post hoc, one prime) at total cost >= 450 sqrt(p).
End-to-end index calculus at p=4129 (prime-order curve) recovered k=3318, matching dlog_bsgs (about 21.7 sqrt(p) counted units, dense elimination uncounted).
next_action: Independent review of the S_4 oracle and M1 counting; record that at m=3 the linear-algebra term 3|V|^2=p^{2/3} alone exceeds sqrt(p); frontier only at m>=5 with a real Groebner/resultant tool (none available) or an FFT-over-mu_h test of the S_4 slice.
